image_description: A close-up, slightly low-angle shot of a home audio setup. Visible are two wall-mounted speakers (one rectangular with a visible cone, one spherical/bullet-shaped), a small cube-shaped subwoofer or satellite speaker on a shelf, and the top corner of a larger floor-standing speaker in the foreground left. The lighting is dim and warm, casting soft shadows.
